Flow.description: Checks, before RLM_ConsolidateRenewalOpportunities renews anything, whether any of the given root assets or their bundle components has an asset state period in a time zone other than GMT (a period with no time zone uses GMT) or in a ramp, was sold from a price book other than the renewal quote's or is in another currency (a renewal must use the price book and currency of the initial sale), whether a quote on any opportunity, open or closed, has a renewal of one of them that hasn't been ordered and activated, whether an open opportunity other than the given ones has a line for one of them, and whether any of the given opportunities already has a quote. Runs in system context without sharing: Start End Time Zone and the ramp fields on Asset State Period and the asset's sales are usually hidden by field-level security, which would fail a read in user context, and a quote the user can't see could still be ordered and renew the same assets. It is given the root assets and opportunities the caller already read and returns only a yes or no for each check, never a record, an Id or a field value.
Flow.label: RLM Renewal Preflight Checks
